note: Create these as Retell custom functions with Payload: args only turned off. Point all URLs at https://<worker-subdomain>.workers.dev/webhooks/retell/custom-function and use POST. The Worker verifies Retell's X-Retell-Signature header with the server-side RETELL_API_KEY secret; do not add or expose an API key in a custom header. Configure the Retell API key that signs webhooks in the Worker secret, and allowlist only the owner's test numbers. Keep retries disabled until idempotency is confirmed in the live workspace.

functions.name: get_availability
functions.description: Check fictional appointment openings. Use only after the caller picks a date and appointment type. Never invent available times.

date.description: Local clinic date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

timezone.description: IANA clinic timezone, for example America/Chicago or Asia/Kolkata.

functions.name: join_waitlist
functions.description: Add a fictional patient to the demo waitlist when no suitable time is available. Confirm the preferred date and sample name first. This creates a staff follow-up only; it does not book an appointment or send a text.

preferred_date.description: Preferred local clinic date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

timezone.description: IANA clinic timezone, for example America/Chicago or Asia/Kolkata.

functions.name: create_appointment
functions.description: Book a fictional appointment only after the caller confirms one returned open slot. Use one of the sample names only.

start_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 instant returned by get_availability.

functions.name: reschedule_appointment
functions.description: Move a fictional appointment only after matching its sample reference and sample name, checking new availability, and receiving the caller's confirmation.

new_start_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 instant returned by get_availability.

functions.name: cancel_appointment
functions.description: Cancel a fictional appointment only after matching the sample reference and sample name, then confirming the cancellation with the caller.

functions.name: search_approved_faq
functions.description: Find an approved front-desk answer. For symptoms, diagnosis, emergencies, or medicine questions, the server returns the approved safety response and a human handoff.

functions.name: request_staff_followup
functions.description: Create a minimal sample staff task for a callback, refill request, records request, billing question, document question, or unanswered FAQ. Do not include the caller's free-text details.

functions.name: check_document_status
functions.description: Read the status of sample referral documents using a sample booking reference and sample patient name.
